title: A Friendship Over Distance
text:
Maria and Ana have been friends since they were children. They live on the same street and go to the same school. Every Saturday, they meet in the park to talk and walk their dogs. Ana says Maria is the best friend she has.

Last month, Maria started a new job in another city. She was sad to leave Ana, so they now talk on the phone every evening. They also make plans to visit each other during the holidays. Ana says that a good friendship is strong even when you are far away.

questions.text: Where do Maria and Ana meet every Saturday?

options: She started a new job in another city

questions.text: How does Ana probably feel about Maria?
What can the reader infer about the friendship between Maria and Ana?
options: It is strong and lasts even over distance
It is only about walking dogs
It is new and has no history

vocabulary.definition: from a particular time in the past until now
a period of time when you do not work or go to school
things you decide to do in the future

paragraph_translations: María y Ana han sido amigas desde que eran niñas. Viven en la misma calle y van a la misma escuela. Cada sábado, se reúnen en el parque para hablar y pasear a sus perros. Ana dice que María es la mejor amiga que tiene.

El mes pasado, María empezó un nuevo trabajo en otra ciudad. Estaba triste por dejar a Ana, así que ahora hablan por teléfono cada noche. También hacen planes para visitarse durante las vacaciones. Ana dice que una buena amistad es fuerte incluso cuando estás lejos.
